services.name: Music Matinee
services.desc: Join us for a delightful musical matinee with Ukulele Mist! Featuring Pam and Bob Davis on ukulele, Jonathan on bass ukulele, and Diann on baritone ukulele, this talented ensemble has been delighting audiences with the joyful sounds of the ukulele for more than ten years. Their performances showcase the instrument family’s surprising versatility through thoughtful arrangements that highlight its warm, acoustic character and rich range of tones. Drawing from a diverse repertoire that includes traditional Hawaiian favorites alongside folk, country, jazz, and pop-rock selections, Ukulele Mist creates a relaxed yet engaging musical experience perfect for a midday performance in the galleries.

services.name: Wellness Day: Shine Yoga
services.desc: At Haggin Museum, wellness is more than a moment-it’s an ongoing journey. The Museum’s Wellness Day series invites the community to restore and recharge through yoga, sound baths, tai chi, author talks, and other enriching experiences designed to nurture mind, body, and spirit. These programs thoughtfully complement the Haggin’s Self-Guided Wellness Tours, which encourage visitors to explore the Museum’s art and history collections through the lens of personal reflection and emotional awareness.
